title: Cataclysm 0.3 — mobile startup and strategic upgrades
prompt: Deliver an ACTUAL tested, published Cataclysm 0.3 core update to the existing docs/preview HTML5 survival game (not a document or proposal). Priority P0: GitHub issue #29 records real Samsung Android failure: the START RUN button did nothing. Investigate boot/version handshake, script loading, disabled button, event binding, cached game.js and runtime exceptions; fix demonstrated causes rather than guessing that joystick input is the culprit. If unavailable on hardware, make diagnostics visible and state physical-phone verification remains pending. Use issue #23 (Cataclysm 0.2 ~886-second gameplay review) for scope. After core startup/input is robust, deliver ONE meaningful 0.3 mechanic: on level-up offer 3 different player-selected upgrades (firing rate with hard cap, damage, movement speed); freeze simulation during choice, apply exactly the chosen upgrade, and resume cleanly. Preserve cat movement, automatic combat, fish, city, survival, health, waves, sound toggle, pause, replay, stable preview URL. Keep controls one-finger friendly; ensure arena gestures do not scroll the page while other page controls still work. Clarify HP/max-HP UI as far as achievable within this bounded run. Avoid broad new art/music/features. No external dependencies or services; only edit the allowlisted Cataclysm target files and coder report, not tests or workflows. Run Node syntax, focused game-specific test(s) of upgrade choice and reset, and the independent Playwright acceptance. Preserve read-only CATACLYSM_DIAGNOSTICS.snapshot() and extend only with copies of actual state for evidence. Rebuild/stamp cache-busting and visible Cataclysm 0.3 version through the publisher; do not claim real Samsung verification. If unable to satisfy the P0 and core acceptance, fail safely instead of publishing or weakening tests.
acceptance: A real tap on the existing #play button starts the game, hides #start-overlay, increments game time and allows actual player movement in both 390x844 and 360x780 touch-emulated browsers; no uncaught errors or missing resources.

Investigate and document the boot path, failed/disabled button risks, script-cache/version agreement and any observed root cause. Provide actionable on-screen initialization errors instead of silently leaving START RUN unusable; retain physical Samsung status as unverified.
Dragging on the arena moves the actual cat, pointercancel releases controls, and gameplay gestures do not scroll the document. Buttons and other page areas remain accessible.

An earned level-up opens exactly three selectable upgrades (fire rate, damage, movement speed). Simulation time and combat freeze during selection, choosing one changes only the corresponding stat, returns to running, and cannot be chosen repeatedly for the same level.
Firing rate upgrades have a bounded nonzero cooldown to avoid a runaway late-game attack exploit. Level and upgrade state reset on a new run.
HP versus max HP is accurately represented, damage does not create impossible heart values, and existing health, score, fish, kills, waves and auto-combat behavior stay functional.
Pause, resume, restart, death and replay work before and after using the new level-up interface. No fake scores or time progression are injected for tests.
Coder runs node --check, real focused gameplay/upgrade logic checks, and reports concrete results. Independent mobile browser acceptance and AI QA must approve actual source and evidence.
Display Cataclysm 0.3 build identity consistently, preserve the existing /preview/ URL and previous Git history; only publish if accepted source hashes match deployed bytes.
